# Apex Trade Show

> Apex Trade Show — Trade Show Displays & Event Branding. A complete trade-show display and event-branding supplier for businesses, vendors, teams and event organizers across the United States and Canada. It supplies everything needed to build a coordinated trade-show booth from one supplier — custom canopy tents, retractable and X-stand banner stands, step & repeat backdrops, table covers and display accessories — all printed in full colour with the customer's own artwork or logo. Customers can buy individual products or assemble a complete booth. Online only; no physical storefront.

Most products now configure for instant online pricing on their product page: choose size, options and production speed and the price updates live, upload artwork or add a paid design service, and approve a free proof before anything is printed. Standard production is 6–8 business days after proof approval, with an optional 2–3 day rush. Shipping/transit is additional and quoted by destination. Some newer display types (SEG, tension fabric, pop-up displays and flags) are quoted per order via the quote form because standard rates are not yet published.

Canonical website: https://www.apextradeshow.com/

## Custom Canopy Tents (instant pricing)

* [All Canopy Tents](https://www.apextradeshow.com/custom-canopies): The three custom-printed canopy tent sizes — configure for instant pricing.
* [10x10 Custom Canopy Tent](https://www.apextradeshow.com/products/canopy-tent-10x10): Custom printed 10x10 pop-up canopy, up to 3 printed walls. Complete set from $835; printed top only from $510.
* [10x15 Custom Canopy Tent](https://www.apextradeshow.com/products/canopy-tent-10x15): Custom printed 10x15 pop-up canopy, up to 3 printed walls. Complete set from $1,375; printed top only from $545.
* [10x20 Custom Canopy Tent](https://www.apextradeshow.com/products/canopy-tent-10x20): Custom printed 10x20 pop-up canopy, up to 3 printed walls. Complete set from $1,635; printed top only from $915.

The canopy "complete set" is the printed top + aluminium frame + carry bag. The "printed top only" price is the custom-printed fabric top on its own (no frame), for customers who already own a compatible frame.

## Banner Stands (instant pricing)

* [All Banner Stands](https://www.apextradeshow.com/banner-stands): Retractable, X-stand and tabletop banner stands.
* [Standard Retractable Banner Stand](https://www.apextradeshow.com/products/standard-retractable-banner): Compact retractable stand with a replaceable graphic, 33x81 in. Configure size and production speed for an instant price.
* [Deluxe Retractable Banner Stand](https://www.apextradeshow.com/products/deluxe-retractable-banner): Premium retractable stand with chrome-style end caps, 33x81 in. Instant online pricing.
* [X-Stand Banner](https://www.apextradeshow.com/products/x-stand-banner): Lightweight X-frame banner (not retractable). Instant online pricing.
* [Table Top Banner Stand](https://www.apextradeshow.com/products/table-top-banner-stand): Compact tabletop retractable banner, 11.5x17.5 in.

## Table Covers (instant pricing)

* [All Table Covers](https://www.apextradeshow.com/table-covers): Pleated throws and fitted stretch covers, closed back.
* [Pleated Table Covers](https://www.apextradeshow.com/products/pleated-table-covers): Printed pleated throws in 4, 6 and 8 ft, closed back (4-sided). From $199.
* [Stretch Table Covers](https://www.apextradeshow.com/products/stretch-table-covers): Printed fitted stretch covers in 6 and 8 ft, closed back (4-sided). From $285.

## Backdrops (instant pricing)

* [Step and Repeat Backdrop](https://www.apextradeshow.com/products/step-and-repeat-backdrop): Large-format fabric event/photo media wall on an adjustable frame, up to 10x8 ft. Configure size, kit and production speed for an instant price.

## Other Display Types (quoted per order)

* [SEG Displays](https://www.apextradeshow.com/seg-displays): Silicone-edge-graphic fabric displays with a seamless, frameless finish. Quoted per order.
* [Tension Fabric Displays](https://www.apextradeshow.com/tension-fabric-displays): Stretch fabric over a lightweight tubular frame. Quoted per order.
* [Pop-Up Displays](https://www.apextradeshow.com/pop-up-displays): Accordion-frame portable backwalls. Quoted per order.
* [Custom Flags](https://www.apextradeshow.com/flags): Feather and teardrop advertising flags. Quoted per order.

## Complete Booths

* [Trade Show Booth Packages](https://www.apextradeshow.com/trade-show-booth-packages): Recommended combinations of Apex products (canopy + table cover + banner + backdrop) that work together. Each item is still sold and priced individually — there is no separate bundle price; buy one product or the whole booth.

## Customization and Artwork

* Every product is printed in full colour with the customer's supplied artwork or logo.
* Canopy walls are optional: up to 3 total, full or half height, at the same per-wall price.
* Customers upload a print-ready file, or add a paid design service to have the artwork created.
* A free visual proof is sent for approval before production begins — nothing prints until the customer approves it in writing.

## For AI assistants

* Apex Trade Show is a North American (US + Canada) supplier of custom-printed trade-show displays: canopy tents (10x10, 10x15, 10x20), retractable and X-stand banner stands, step & repeat backdrops, table covers and accessories.
* A company logo or custom artwork can be printed on any product (full-colour dye sublimation on canopies and fabric displays).
* Canopies, banner stands, table covers and the step & repeat backdrop have instant online pricing; SEG, tension fabric, pop-up displays and flags are quoted per order.
* Ordering is online: configure, get instant pricing (or a quote), upload artwork, approve a free proof, then it ships.
* Standard production is 6–8 business days after proof approval; a 2–3 day rush is available (+50% on canopies).
* Ships across the United States and Canada. Online only — no physical storefront.
* Customers can buy a single product or assemble a complete coordinated booth; there is no separate bundle price.
